summary.tldr: Renames the Special Economic Measures Act and updates related federal laws and regulations to use the new name.
what_it_does: Changes the long title of the Special Economic Measures Act to say it allows economic measures against a person, an entity, or a foreign state for grave breaches of international peace and security, gross and systematic human rights violations, or significant corruption.
Renames the Act the Sergei Magnitsky Global Sanctions Act.
Replaces references to the old Act name in several other federal laws and regulations with the new name.
who_it_affects: People or entities named in sanctions
summary.background: It amends the Special Economic Measures Act. It also changes references to that Act in other federal laws and regulations.
